audit.ladder: true unless the scaled-edit construction fails (A5.3.1 'audit-excluded')
audit.rotation: A5.3.3 outcome-free rotation audit of the donor edit (pass = true)
audit.status: computed at G0/G1 closure from metadata/bytes, never from outcomes

consumer: scripts/a5_simulation.py (validate: --inputs-spec this file; run: INPUT --output SIZE.json)

donors.missing: a row lacking either record is not a donor; it is listed with its reason in provenance.missing; no imputation. An empty (family, tertile) donor cell leaves calibration unresolved (A5.3.2)
donors.records: data/evals/qwen3.5-0.8b/tf_v1/<id>/records.jsonl, primary run (repeat_id null); the reference is 'base' for roots and the actual predecessor (parent_id) for chain steps; both must pass src/wsp/eval/response_intervention.py:_reference_on_file with the same scoring identity (config_hash, model_revision, source_hash, device), as references.json checks
donors.rows: eligible inventory rows that are D3 development members with a TF-v1 primary record and a matched predecessor-reference record on file after G0/G1 closure

input_file.commit: its sha256, inventory and provenance enter docs/prereg/a5_manifests/ before NULL-SIZE
input_file.format: JSON object (or NPZ with the same JSON as scalar Unicode 'payload', no pickle)

inventory.cutpoints: frozen from this inventory by scripts/a5_simulation.py:selection_cells
inventory.source: docs/prereg/a5_manifests/components.jsonl rows with family in family_map (frozen selection inventory, A5.3.1); every such row is listed, eligible or not

payload_schema.donor_row: an inventory row plus residuals [64,3] and audit [3]

inventory_row.eligible: components.jsonl eligibility == 'eligible' (chair ruling A5.3.1: predecessor-lost rows are ineligible)
inventory_row.norm: components.jsonl effective_norm (finite for eligible rows; may be null otherwise)

provenance_layout: provenance = {'donors': {donor id: {edit_record_sha256, reference_id, reference_record_sha256, run_ids}}, 'missing': {inventory id: reason}}; record hashes are sha256 of the records.jsonl bytes

residuals.columns: E_edit[w], E_rotation[w], E_predecessor[w]: raw per-window values, NOT centred; the simulation centres U_x = E_x - E_predecessor (A5.3.2)
residuals.field: extra.mean_nll (nats per valid next token; each window has n_tokens 1023, so the mean over windows is token-weighted)
residuals.nonfinite: a missing/nonfinite window value is written as NaN (JSON NaN) and becomes an audit/nonfinite failure of that contrast in the simulation; never replaced
residuals.window_order: item_id '0'..'63' = text_groups.json windows in order; the simulation forms the 32 two-window blocks (2k, 2k+1)

rotation_column.issue: A5.3.2 says G1 TF-v1 development records supply (edit, rotation, predecessor) residuals, but rotation variants are first scored at G3 (A5.3.4, S31 §3 G3): no TF-v1 rotation record exists for any development row. The NULL-SIZE payload cannot be formed as specified.
options_for_ruling: score development rotations at G0/G1 (priced under A5.2.2) and use their records
an amended null model that uses only the edit and predecessor columns

rotation_source: string naming the registered rotation_column source; must be in allowed_sources
status: specification only; not run on real data; inputs exist only after G0/G1 closure (A5.3.2, A5.11)
